title: Musializer font import manifest v1
description: What tools/google_fonts.py wrote after retrieving one caption face. The application re-computes both digests against the files on disk before either is trusted; this manifest is a description of a download, never a warrant for it.

family.description: The family as Google Fonts names it. A display label only: the bytes are identified by their digest.

source.description: Where the face came from, recorded so a surprising result can be traced. Constrained to the declared host.

font_path.description: The downloaded TrueType file, in the job's own output directory.

font_bytes.description: Size of the face. Bounded so a redirect to something enormous fails before it fills a disk.

licence_path.description: The terms the family is distributed under. Always present: a face whose licence could not be retrieved is refused rather than bundled without it, because copying it into a shareable project is redistribution.

licence_name.description: Which terms these are, taken from the directory google/fonts sorts the family into rather than guessed from the text.
